The environment map texture ($8192 \times 4096 \times 3$ bytes $\approx 100$ MB for 32-bit float, or less for 16-bit) is added to memory footprint.

*   **When to Use:** Interactive VR applications, semi-bounded environments with well-defined navigation areas, scenes with significant distant background elements that cause floaters or performance issues.
*   **When Not to Use:** Applications requiring precise motion parallax for mid-distance objects, or where high-fidelity novel view synthesis metrics for distant regions are critical.
It addresses the challenges of rendering large-scale outdoor scenes with 3D Gaussian Splatting, where distant background elements often suffer from noise (floaters) and high computational cost.

By baking the background into a static environment map, the method leverages the efficiency of traditional environment map rendering while maintaining the high-quality foreground reconstruction of 3DGS.
